ORDINANCE XV OF 2007
ORDINANCE XV OF 2007
LAND ACQUISITION
(SINDH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE,
2007.
An Ordinance to amend
the Land Acquisition Act,
1894, in its application
to the Province
of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
4th August, 2007]
No.S.Legis:1(15)/2007, dated 4-8-2007.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:---
Preamble.---Whereas the Federal Shariat Court
has directed to make certain amendments in the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, in
its application to the Province
of Sindh;
And whereas it is expedient to amend the
Land Acquisition Act, 1894, in its application to the Province of Sindh, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of the
Proclamation of the fifth day of July, 1977 and the Provisional Constitution
Order, 1981, the Governor of Sindh is pleased to make
and promulgate the following Ordinance:---
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Land
Acquisition (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2007.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 16 of Act No.I of 1894

[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,

No.S.Legis:1(15)/2007, dated 4-8-2007.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:---
Preamble.---Whereas the Federal Shariat Court
has directed to make certain amendments in the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, in
its application to the Province
of Sindh;
And whereas it is expedient to amend the
Land Acquisition Act, 1894, in its application to the Province of Sindh, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of the
Proclamation of the fifth day of July, 1977 and the Provisional Constitution
Order, 1981, the Governor of Sindh is pleased to make
and promulgate the following Ordinance:---
2. Amendment of section 16 of Act No.I of 1894.---In the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, in
its application to the Province of Sindh, hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, in section 16, the full stop at end shall be
replaced by a
colon and the
following proviso shall
be added:---
"Provided that the amount of
compensation is to be paid to the owner of land or deposited in civil court in
his name by the acquisitioning authority before taking over possession of
land."

Act No.I of 1894.---In the said Act, in section
23, in subsection (1) and the Explanation thereunder
and in section 24, for the figure "4" the figure "6" shall
be substituted.
